notes: ABox expansion paired with physics-replace-0001 (The Moon orbits Mars): the same relation and new object, with a made-up moon in an empty slot. Mars has only Phobos and Deimos on record, so a further small moon could exist unrecorded. The three derived questions are compositions through Mars: its atmosphere, a sibling moon, and its tallest volcano. Near unrelated: another moon with its own planet (Ganymede, Jupiter), so a leak of Mars would be caught.
